one_month_reasoning: Inside the window: (1) Q3 2026 results, not yet announced; the company gives about two weeks' notice and Q3 2025 was reported 2025-11-05, so ~2026-11-04/05 is an estimate. Q3 is seasonally light; the news will be cash after the $489M raise and Westerman, H2 deployment against the $350-500M guide, any TENEX 2026-27 waiver news and the Oak Ridge first-centrifuge target. (2) The 60-day company lock-up in the 424B5 (dated 2026-09-09) ends ~2026-11-08, after which the ATM can be used again: a supply overhang. No binary event; the stock is down 37% since 2026-09-04 with ~30% of float short and trades with the nuclear basket and the 10-year yield (5.26% on 2026-10-14). Squeeze risk offsets negative momentum and the ATM overhang, so I keep the distribution near-symmetric with a slight downward tilt (median ~$108) at the usual monthly volatility (89%/3.5 = 25%).

fair_value.method: Engine blend of a DCF on the finite-life trading book plus milestone rNPVs of the LEU and HALEU cascades (0.40, $26.58), a cash-floor-plus-option tree (0.33, $27.01), market-share states (0.22, $21.88) and a 6x EV/EBITDA cross-check (0.05, $28.60) = $25.79 at the horizon. Net cash ($525M, ~$21/share) and Westerman carry the value; at ~$1,430/SWU-yr and ~$200/SWU the build is worth about zero to slightly negative in expectation.

bear.story: Fundamental value ~$13.0 (engine bear): TENEX waiver or export licence lapses so 2027 deliveries fall short; the first capex disclosure lands at ACP-like cost and the build slips past 2030; equity raised near $50-70. The stock trades toward cash plus a small option; some scarcity premium stays, so ~$40.

base.story: Fundamental value ~$25.8 (engine base). Execution on track (first Oak Ridge centrifuge, ~$700M deployed in 2027) but capex and contract prices stay undisclosed or come in near my estimate, the trading book shrinks into 2028 and the ATM is used. The scarcity premium for the only US-owned enricher fades only partly over 12 months, so ~$82.

bull.story: Fundamental value ~$43 (engine bull) plus the strategic premium coming back: capex disclosed near Orano's cost in the reused ACP buildings, large prepaid offtakes at a US-origin premium, a further DOE LEU/HALEU award, nuclear sentiment recovers with lower yields.

comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: There is no listed pure-play enrichment peer (Urenco, Orano and Rosatom are state or privately held), so fewer than 10 genuine comparables exist. The discount reflects the finite life of the core earnings: the TENEX contract ends in 2028, Import Ban waivers end in 2027 and Orano supply ends in 2030 (10-K/10-Q), so the core EBITDA has no terminal value like BWXT's naval franchise or CEG's fleet. thesis_break_reason: $28 is my horizon cash floor (net cash $525M + Westerman $116M + run-off core $75M = $28.84/share). Ordinary 89%-vol swings and the fading scarcity premium should not take it there (P ~4%).

reasoning: Primary-document lane. The 10-K/10-Q show that the profitable part of Centrus, a trading book reselling TENEX/Orano SWU, is finite: waivers end 2027, TENEX 2028, Orano 2030, firm LEU RPO ~$0.7B. Value rests on net cash and the Piketon build (~1.15M SWU LEU + 12 t/yr HALEU, first output 2029, 'multi-billion' cost). Round 2 fixes: the General Matter mark is out (no primary source), SBC shares are out, corporate SG&A is now in the engine years (round 1 omitted it), and both converts are at face. I also re-based capex on primary evidence: USEC's own ACP budget for the same machine family at the same site ($3.5B for 3.8M SWU, FY2008 10-K) is ~$1,390/SWU-yr in today's dollars, against ~$740 for Orano's brownfield GB2 extension. At ~$1,430/SWU-yr, $200/SWU and a 50% margin, the initial build is worth about zero to slightly negative in expectation even with the DOE $900M (PV $597M), on a 40/35/25 tree from base rates. Engine fair value $25.79 (DCF $26.6, tree $27.0, market-share $21.9, 6x cross-check $28.6); capex is the swing factor ($46 at Orano-like cost, $13.5 at +20%). For the traded-price ladder I still do not assume convergence to fair value within 12 months: the stock is a sentiment and rates proxy (-71% in a year, 89% vol, ~30% short) and the scarcity premium for the only US-owned enricher is durable. But the ladder is lower than in round 1, as the first capex disclosure is more likely to disappoint and the ATM returns after ~11-08. Bear $40 (30%), base $82 (50%), bull $170 (20%), each lognormal with 35% vol: median ~$76, mean ~$92, P(>=$110) 0.28. Round-2 research: confirmed in the 424B5 (Westerman ~$160M revenue, 60-day company lock-up) and 10-Q (task-order schedule, customer advances falling); no Q3 date or waiver decision yet (web search 2026-10-21); ACP and Orano GB2 cost data (USEC 10-K, WNN, IPFM, Orano); EIA SWU market size (ANS).

custom.explanation: Floor at the horizon: run-off core EV $75M + Westerman $116M + net cash $525M = $716M ($28.84/share on 24.83M). E = -$173M; ($716M floor - $173M) / 24.83M = $21.88.

model_inputs.structure_note: The standard structure cannot describe a business whose value is a 2029-31 enrichment plant not yet built, so: the years hold only the core (TENEX/Orano-supplied LEU trading book + Technical Solutions, with corporate SG&A now in years[].corporate_ebit), which is finite-life (TENEX 2028, Orano 2030) and fades from FY2028; the initial Piketon build is two rnpv programmes in adjustment mode (LEU cascades; HALEU cascades with a demand phase and the DOE $900M milestones), with dated capex as expected dev costs; Westerman is an equity adjustment at cost; pre-horizon deployment, interest, DOE receipts and an expected raise are in net_debt_horizon. Custom legs carry the brief's methods: (a)+(e) cash floor plus milestone tree with abandonment (0.33) and (b) market-share states with price-linked shares and a mature-company margin (0.22); EV/EBITDA is a 0.05 cross-check. The General Matter private mark is dropped (weight 0). Value is carried by net cash; on my capex evidence the build is worth about zero to slightly negative in expectation.
model_inputs.gap_note: Judgment calls for Kilian: (1) expansion capex ~$2.35B from Oct-2026 (~$1,430/SWU-yr) is my estimate from USEC's ACP budget inflated to 2026 and Orano's GB2 extension; the company says only 'multi-billion'. It is the biggest lever: x0.65 (Orano-like) gives $46.2, x0.8 $37.3, x1.2 $13.5. (2) the 40/35/25 on-time/late/abandon tree (derivation in inputs_detail) is untested; 70/20/10 gives $31.9. (3) converts at face (market-value variant +$5-7/share). (4) the General Matter mark is excluded (+~$10/share at weight 0.12). (5) ~$6.6/share of the value comes from the expected raise at ~$95, above my value (accretive). fair_value.value equals the engine base horizon value ($25.79). DCF check: the DCF leg ($26.58) and the custom legs ($27.01, $21.88) agree within ~$5; the 'multiples imply a 5.7% WACC' flag reflects the cross-check multiple, not a valuation choice.
